scares.description: The baby suddenly opens its eyes and Sadako’s hair flies out of her mouth.
A woman jumps out of the well towards the camera. (There are a few seconds of her climbing up as a warning beforehand.)
Something causes Fuko to be startled and then there is a cut to a dead body in the bath tub.
As the body bag is opened a hand reaches out of it.
As Fuko is running up to the apartment the nanny drops onto the car next to her.
The seemingly dead nanny grabs Fuko by the leg.
Koiso whispers Sadako, followed by a cut to Nagi pushing his wheelchair from behind.
The lights turn off, and as they come back on Sadako runs at the camera.
A coat hanging on a rack suddenly turns into a woman and attacks Fuko.
A woman jumps out of the computer screen.
Fuko’s mon drops down under the bed and growls at her.
Takanori’s face suddenly begins to distort and he runs at Fuko.
Nagi is suddenly grabbed by Fuko.
Someone jumps through a glass window, shattering it and grabbing the detective.
